required_elements.criterion: Past mugging explains usual avoidance of large cash; daughter's kidnapping creates need to carry ransom.
Demand is much greater than one million: dummy paper bundles with real notes on outside create apparent full ransom while actual cash is one million.
He fears violence if kidnappers discover the shortfall/deception; replaces top bundles with real notes to make inspection less revealing, hence increases cash.

acceptance: All causal narrative elements required, faithful paraphrases accepted. No arbitrary exact wording, names, counts or narrative decoration beyond rubric. Never give solver missing elements. False/incomplete final gets no and game continues.
